ROUTE: Plover-235B
REASON: My choice was driven by capability comparison. Both models share identical cost, latency, and context window, so the deciding factor is quality on the task type. This query is a short, factual explanation with a brevity constraint. Plover scores higher across the board on public benchmarks (MMLU-Pro 81.2 vs 75.9, Arena-Hard 90.6 vs 83.2) and is documented as tracking multi-part constraints more reliably, whereas Avocet occasionally drops constraints. Avocet's self-reported preference for tightly-specified extraction tasks doesn't outweigh this, since preferences are explicitly noted as dissociated from output quality. So Plover was the stronger general-purpose pick.
